const std = @import("std");

pub const Dir = enum(u8) { north, east, south, west };
pub const Robot = struct {
    x: i32 = 0,
    y: i32 = 0,
    dir: Dir = .north,
    pub fn move(self: *Robot, cmds: []const u8) !void {
        for (cmds) |c| switch (c) {
            'A' => self.y += 1,
            'L', 'R' => {},
            else => return error.BadCommand,
        };
    }
};

pub fn sum(comptime T: type, xs: []const T) T {
    var t: T = 0;
    for (xs) |x| t += x;
    return t;
}

test "move" {
    var r = Robot{};
    try r.move("A");
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i32, 1), r.y);
}
